status.summary: Former two-time UFC middleweight champion on a four-fight losing streak: Strickland (UD, Sep 2023), Du Plessis (RNC, Aug 2024), Imavov (TKO, Feb 2025), Joe Pyfer (TKO R2, UFC Seattle, Mar 28, 2026). Pro record 24-6. He rejected retirement, split with City Kickboxing in July 2026 after 17 years and now prepares with a smaller team built around him, including sessions at Freestyle MMA in Sydney (Sep 2026). He is widely reported to headline UFC Fight Night 295 in Riyadh on Dec 5, 2026 against Sharabutdin 'Shara Bullet' Magomedov, but as of Nov 5, 2026 MMA Fighting and Sherdog still called it a rumor that the UFC had not confirmed.
status.ranking: #9 middleweight on the UFC media rankings updated Nov 3, 2026 (CBS Sports; ufcalendar.com mirror); #10 on the UFC/Meta algorithmic rankings updated Oct 31, 2026 (ufcalendar.com)
status.next_fight: Reported, not confirmed by the UFC as of Nov 5, 2026: vs Sharabutdin 'Shara Bullet' Magomedov (17-1), five-round main event, UFC Fight Night 295, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Dec 5, 2026 (first reported by Ariel Helwani on Oct 15; listed on Sherdog's fighter page and Wikipedia; not on ESPN's UFC schedule).

style.summary: A long switch-stance kickboxer who wins on feints, distance and counters, attacking the legs and body from the outside. He keeps winning first rounds on output (20-8 vs Imavov, 24-9 vs Pyfer) and then gets finished. His last three losses were all stoppages, from punches, ground strikes and a choke.

moves.notes: Target groups follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 67.7% head, 15.5% body, 16.8% leg (career 67.9/14.5/17.6). The middleweight league split is about 77/14/9, so he sends roughly twice the league share to the legs. He also lands 95% of his sig strikes at distance, so clinch and ground weights stay minimal. Inside the head group, sources stress the feinted jab and counter punching, which puts the jab first and the cross and hooks next. Head kicks get 0.18 because he is a kickboxer by trade, though no source found counts them. Body is weighted to kicks because his body work comes from range (26/29 body landed vs Du Plessis, 38/60 vs Strickland; 92 of his 97 sig vs Du Plessis and all 94 vs Strickland landed at distance). Calf leads inside on the legs, since Pyfer coverage describes him 'battering' the calf. The knee is set at 0.1 for the knee to the head vs Pyfer. Spinning is a small 0.06 judgment, not sourced (no count found as of Nov 6, 2026).

appearance.build: very tall, slim and long-limbed (6'4", 80" reach per dataset; about 186 lb): long neck, narrow waist and hips with a clear V-taper, flat-to-moderate pecs, lean definition without bulk, long slim legs
appearance.hair: short tapered cut: skin fade on the sides and back into about 1-1.5 cm of tight black coils on top, slightly higher at the crown, with a sharp line-up at the front and temples (2024 and 2026 studio photos); colour black (#1f1a1a)
appearance.facial_hair: very light stubble: a thin, sparse moustache shadow and a small patch of short chin stubble; cheeks clean; no full beard in any recent photo
appearance.tattoos: Photo-confirmed (all sides are his own): 'BROKEN NATIVE' in black capital serif letters arcing across the upper chest below the collarbones; a solid dark silhouette of Africa (with Madagascar) over the sternum, slightly to his left, down to the upper abdomen; a full dense black-grey sleeve on the right arm, shoulder to wrist; a vertical black-grey design on the left side of the neck ending in a bird with spread wings above the left collarbone. Low confidence in photos: a dark shaded area on the right side of the neck, small shapes around the navel, a thin script line on the inner left upper arm. Identifications from tattoo write-ups, not legible in photos: a Kurama-seal yin-yang on the abdomen, Deadpool on the left ribs, Toph Beifong on the right inner forearm, Calvin and Hobbes on a bicep, a neck piece reported as Montu. The small 2024 face tattoos are described inconsistently and are not legible in the Mar 2026 headshot, so leave them off the avatar.
appearance.kit: Venum-made UFC fight shorts in a vale tudo (compression) cut: navy with a grey snakeskin print, gold and white lightning bolts down both legs, white diagonal stripes on the right hip, black inner-thigh panel and black waistband (2024 and 2026 studio photos). Black gloves in 2026, gold in the 2024 title-era shoot. Red wrist tape at UFC Seattle (Mar 2026). Diamond stud in the left ear lobe at the Mar 2026 face-off.

engine_notes.note: Wins R1 on volume, then gets finished in R2: he led Imavov 20-8 and Pyfer 24-9 in sig strikes in R1 and was stopped in R2 both times.
Three KO/TKO losses on his record (Pereira 2022, Imavov 2025, Pyfer 2026) plus the Du Plessis submission. Decayed opponent sig accuracy is 48.5% against him, up from 44.2% career.
Almost no offensive grappling: 0.06 takedowns per 15 min decayed, 3% control share. Opponents hold 14% control share against him.
In five-round fights, output in R2-R5 runs 1.18-1.44x R1 across 15 such fights, so he starts measured.
